posts.author: Synchromystic
posts.body:
The YouTube channel "SideMV" has recently made and streamed a few videos demonstrating how to make a fairly attractive sidescrolling platformer in MV using some already-available plugins, including the free "Jump Action" plugin... But I'm working in MZ, and would LOVE to have something similar. One additional feature that would be INCREDIBLY helpful, if possible, would be to add a plugin command that turns this function on / off. Ideally, that would allow me to enable it during mini-games and other short segments of the game, and then disable it for the main overhead RPG areas. This would open up the entire RPG MAKER engine to a whole new world of possibilities, and since these plugins have apparently already made it possible in MV, it seems like it should be a simply process to convert to an MZ plugin -- I'm kind of amazed it hasn't been done already... Or has it?
I'm pretty sure all of the other necessary plugins used in this template already have MZ versions, but the jump dynamic is one thing that I've struggled to find a solution for. I'm broke as a joke, but this is something I would be willing to pay for, if necessary.

posts.author: Synchromystic
posts.body:
That clunkiness that you mention is exactly what I'm trying to avoid, and the demonstrations in that SideMV video are the first time I've ever seen anyone do a decent job at it without requiring some kind of coding knowledge -- especially that part near the end of the video. I mean, holy crap, if I hadn't seen the Editor screen while he was loading it up, I never would've believed that was done in RPG Maker!
I already own the Eli Jump System plugin, that's definitely not going to accomplish anything as smooth as what's shown in the video above. Somehow hadn't noticed the TSR_MapJump plugin before, but that doesn't appear to be much different from the Eli one. I also have a Visustella plugin that adds a pretty similar jump feature... But ALL of these are horribly limited and don't give the feel of a platformer at all.
I'm looking at the file for the TMJumpAction plugin right now, and this thing does way more than I realized: It has parameters for gravity, friction, slip, fall rate, altering speed when moving through water and other environments, bullet types, and other attack / guard parameters, etc, etc... But I'm assuming it won't work with MZ. I'd have a tough time even figuring that out for sure, because it probably requires a bit of setup, and half of the text is in Japanese. Definitely crashes if I just toss it in my project and try to play.
Almost sounds like I would be asking someone to build me an entire game physics engine by trying to recreate what that plugin does... But it sure would be nice! Guess I'll go back to dreaming for now...

the best probably is any pixel movement, block input (up/down) and only

when up/down is pressed.

whatever your approach is or can be, this might be the cleanest way.

this.
